purpose: Optional motion drafting and localized clip repair before final animation

draftFromFirstFrame.prompt: [0-3s] Locked-off static camera. The cut-paper file cards slide into place one by one with restrained stop-motion bounce and soft paper taps. [3-5s] Hold the final composition. Preserve the fibrous paper texture, halftone dots, cut edges and lower-right shadows.
draftFromFirstFrame.name: Scene 01 - Omni motion draft

localizedEdit.prompt: Make only the top paper card forest green. Keep everything else exactly the same.
localizedEdit.name: Scene 01 - green card repair

referenceDraft.prompt: Create a new locked-off cut-paper scene using Image 1 as the character and Image 2 as the material and color reference. The character pushes one file card into a paper machine, then pauses proudly.
referenceDraft.name: Scene 02 - Omni reference draft

constraints.inputRule: Use exactly one of firstFrame, refImages, or continueFrom
constraints.textRule: Add exact Chinese, UI, URLs, and wordmarks later as deterministic overlays
